tmp:0943: the revelation of chesed as love and yearning ('cholat ahavah') — disclosure of the kindness-attribute at the guarded brit, manifest as longing for God

tmp:0952: through each and every act of teshuvah — repentance performed repeatedly, each one effecting the higher and lower unifications

tmp:0958: Moshe's power to atone — the capacity in Moshe's hand to effect kapparah for the sin of the golden calf through his self-effacing prayer
tmp:0959: praying while binding thought to speech — the mode of tefillah in which machashavah is consciously attached to dibbur, forming the vessel of blessing

tmp:0961: afiyah — 'baking' (afinan, from Rabbah bar bar Chanah's tale) as the tzaddikim's ripening/preparation of the accumulated prayers, building the Shekhinah toward union
tmp:0963: bishul — 'cooking' (bashlinan) of the prayers by the tzaddikim of each generation, maturing them so they bear fruit rather than lying barren

tmp:0967: subduing the medameh — the humbling of the imaginative faculty, the ruach ra'ah/ruach shtut, achieved by the hand-played melody that clarifies the spirit of prophecy
tmp:0968: the heart hears — the hearing-capacity of the lev awakened by thunder (gevurot-voice), yielding 'the meditation of my heart is understanding'

tmp:0974: the pyre of the seventy stars nullified — the medurah of shiv'in kokhvin (Zoharic image of the lust of niuf/gilui arayot, 'leimor') extinguished by perfecting Lashon HaKodesh
tmp:0975: the mochichim — the rebukers of the generation, symbolized as raglin (feet/legs, 'ekev'), to whom the judgments are revealed

tmp:0989: Chokhmah as knowledge of Torah — wisdom qua yedi'at haTorah, the sweetener of Yitzchak's din, embodied in Yaakov (speech with knowledge)
